timeout 300 npx vitest run src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -50
timeout 300 npm run test -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --testNamePattern="listing conversations" 2>&1 | tail -40
timeout 300 npm run test -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -15
npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/sender.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "unchanged"
timeout 300 npm run test -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --testNamePattern="answers a list_sessions frame" 2>&1 | tail -15
git add src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/sender.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): handle list_sessions frames over WebSocket

Implement WebSocket message handler for list_sessions frames, enabling clients to retrieve conversation summaries. The handler:
- Calls sessionStore.listFor(userId, {limit, before}) to fetch summaries
- Serializes Date fields to ISO-8601 strings for JSON transmission
- Handles errors by logging and returning SERVER_ERROR frames
- Omits list_sessions validation from the main message lock (answers immediately like ping)

Includes sendSessionList helper in sender.ts and test coverage for the handler.

Fixes re-cinq/HALEngine#144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
refactor: extract shared WebSocket test utilities

Move duplicate helper functions from test files to wsTestSupport.ts to reduce code duplication and lint warnings. Extracted:
- eventually() - polling helper used by multiple test suites
- delegatingTo() - SessionStore wrapper for testing optional methods

This addresses no-duplicate-code and member-chain lint errors across WebSocket test files.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
timeout 300 npm run test -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts --testNamePattern="answers a list_sessions frame" 2>&1 | tail -10
timeout 300 npm run test -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -10

git add src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(validation): properly type list_sessions validation result

Import and use ListSessionsMessage type instead of generic Record in validateListSessionsMessage to satisfy TypeScript strict type checking.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
